title: HUD hint text changed — contradicts acceptance 4's byte-identical existing goldens
evidence:
+		draw_text(app, "draw source->router->sink; select a pipe + U previews its upgrade; watch the forecast", 12, 36, 16, p.ink_soft)

4. **Golden discipline** — NEW demo `forecast_shift.dem` + NEW golden files only; every existing golden must stay byte-identical (harness run green on all demos; any shift = STOP and flag).
detail: The hint line is drawn every frame (else branch of placing), so every existing T2 golden capture re-renders differently. The same diff forbids any existing-golden shift and regenerates no existing goldens — self-contradiction; the harness must flag all demos.
recommended_fix: Keep the original hint string in this diff, or regenerate every existing golden and drop the byte-identical claim from acceptance 4.

title: tiers scratch allocated by pipe_alive length but filled by pipe_tier length
detail: Two different length bases: if pipe_tier is longer than pipe_alive the copy loop writes past the allocation (panic); if shorter, tail slots are never priced with real tiers. The same pattern is duplicated in the pin test's predicted-table build.
recommended_fix: Allocate with len(t.pipe_tier) — the loop's own bound — and assert the two lengths match.

title: Magnet telegraph counts shifted pairs but labels them flows
detail: Route_Shift is one entry per (from,dst) pair ("for every (from, dst) live node pair whose equal-cost next-hop SET changes, one Route_Shift entry"), so magnet is a pair count; the card prints "attracts N flows". The demo spawns four packets per pair — N undercounts real flows.
recommended_fix: Either label it "attracts N routes" or carry a per-pair flow count in Route_Shift.

title: Disarm paths leave preview_shifts allocated until re-arm or run end
detail: Disarming (pipe gone, widest tier, deselect) clears preview_active but never delete(app.preview_shifts); stale storage lingers until the next successful recompute swap or start_run. Bounded, but inconsistent with the app-owned/freed-on-recompute contract.
recommended_fix: delete(app.preview_shifts) on every disarm path before returning.
